initialize_flags: initialize command-line flags from a config file and handle deprecated formats
get_config_object: get a Config object containing all non-deprecated flag values set from command-line arguments
handle_config_defaults: handle config defaults and resolve hidden_size from num_params budget
flags_as_dict: return a dictionary of flags that were explicitly provided on the command line
create_config_object: create a Config object with dot-notation access to flat configuration options
